items.a: Yes. The parts are standard: [membranes and instruments bought from their makers]. Membranes, electrodeionization (EDI) modules and resin arrive with makers' certificates and serial or lot numbers. Our work is the design, the joints and the tests; each leaves a record you can check.

items.q: Are the figures from your tests or ours?
items.a: Both, by stage. Factory acceptance test (FAT) figures come from our shop, measured on our feed water. Site acceptance test (SAT) and operational qualification (OQ) figures are measured on your site. Performance qualification (PQ) data is your team's.

items.q: Does a passed FAT mean the system meets USP?
items.a: No. A factory acceptance test (FAT) proves function before shipment, on our feed water. United States Pharmacopeia (USP) quality at your points of use is shown on your water. That is performance qualification (PQ), after site acceptance testing (SAT) and operational qualification (OQ).
